title: Dock & Disorder
subtitle: Warehouse Puzzle Game
shortDescription: A warehouse-themed puzzle game concept about sorting incoming goods into the right zones before time runs out.
longDescription: Dock & Disorder turns logistics work into play: a warehouse puzzle game where incoming goods must be sorted into the right zones before time runs out. It is a design-driven side project — short puzzle loops documented through game-design notes, aimed at a web-first implementation.
problem: A creative side project exploring how logistics operations can become a game — turning warehouse sorting into short puzzle loops.
solution: A web-first puzzle game concept where incoming goods must be sorted into the right zones before time runs out, documented through game-design notes.
responsibilities: Designed the core sorting loop and difficulty curve

decisions.title: Design before code
decisions.rationale: The puzzle loop was documented and tuned on paper first so the implementation has a tested core to build on.

impact: Creative project combining logistics context and game design
